appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.

Horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for each year from 1880 to 1891.
A single blue line traces the data, starting near 1,100 in 1880 and ending near 3,200 in 1891.
The line shows a general upward trend, with a notable peak around 3,500 in 1890, followed by a slight dip in 1891.
